issue_context.title: Tests Die When IAsyncDisposable Service is Used
issue_context.body:
When using a Service that implements `IAsyndDisposable`, tests are crashing:


> The active test run was aborted. Reason: Test host process crashed : Unhandled exception. System.InvalidOperationException: 'Marv.Apex.Broadcast.ApexBroadcasterService<Marv.Apex.Messages.ApexEnvelope>' type only implements IAsyncDisposable. Use DisposeAsync to dispose the container.
>    at Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceLookup.ServiceProviderEngineScope.Dispose()
>    at Orleans.Runtime.Catalog.DestroyActivation(ActivationData activationData, CancellationToken ct)
>    at Orleans.Runtime.Catalog.<>c__DisplayClass75_0.<<DeactivateActivation>b__0>d.MoveNext()
> 

Making the service `IDisposable` and calling (without awaiting) the `DisposeAsync` method works around the issue, though.
comments: Hi Thiago, I believe you should implement IDisposable if you implement IAsyncDisposable. That being said, Catalog should call DisposeAsync if it's supported. Are you able to make a PR against the 3.3.0 branch to implement that and help prevent people from hitting this in future?

review_comments: I think we should make this both IDisposable and IAsyncDisposable

I just did. 
But I wonder why this is not the case on master.
